facts.business: J.K. Cement Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of grey cement, white cement, wall putty, and paints, with operations in India and overseas subsidiaries in Africa and Fujairah.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Work in Progress (Projects in Progress)
Capital Work in Progress (Projects Temporarily Suspended)
Employee benefits expenses capitalised during FY 2025-26

guidance_or_targets.statement: Cement demand is expected to surge by 7-8% in FY 2026-27, with infrastructure activity anticipated to witness a marginal uptick.
Industry capacity addition of roughly 75 MnTPA is anticipated in FY 2026-27, with total installed capacity reaching ~975 MnTPA by end of FY 2030-31.
Operating rates are projected to average at ~72% in FY 2026-27 due to significant capacity additions.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on (i) uncertainty related to ongoing litigation with Competition Commission of India (Note 37A(5)), and (ii) amalgamation of Toshali Cements Private Limited accounted from NCLT sanctioned appointed date instead of acquisition date per Ind AS 103 (Note 47). Conclusion not modified.

key_risks: El Niño causing below-normal monsoon (90% of LPA) with 60% probability, threatening agriculture, food inflation, and broader economy
GDP growth projected to moderate to 6.6% in FY 2026-27 per RBI revised estimate
Significant capacity additions (~75 MnTPA in FY 2026-27, ~250 MnTPA by FY 2030-31) likely to moderate operating rates to ~72%
Ongoing litigation with Competition Commission of India (CCI) with contingent liabilities of Rs 333.82 Crores (excluding Rs 137.82 Crores and interest of Rs 26.38 Crores related to CCI case)
Taxation litigations across multiple jurisdictions with uncertain outcomes
Geopolitical uncertainties, rising crude oil prices (> $110/barrel), and external inflationary pressures
